items.html: And the NH are called the hooks of the pillars, which are Yachin and Boaz, the two thighs in the form of two hooks. And also since the NH came out from the Tifferet, which is the letter Vav, and they too became the aspect of hooks, which are the hairs, which are in the form of hooks. And therefore the hairs of the head come out from below upward, in the form of hooks, for they pass through the membrane of the air, which is the Tifferet, and go out outside, and become hooks like it. And they are reflected light, for they are Gevurot. And these are the secret of the thirteen strands of the hairs of the Rosh, mentioned in the Idra, and in chapters 9 and 10 their matter will be explained; see there.
